newsitem.title: USA: Camelot can't explain stock price, trading volume.
newsitem.headline: Camelot can't explain stock price, trading volume.

text.p: Camelot Corp said Wednesday that it can not explain the unprecedented fall in its common stock price, nor can it explain the level of trading.
There has been no insider trading, said Camelot, and it knows of no inside information that would result in these stock prices and trading volume actions.
"I am at a loss to understand why this price level and trading volume is occurring," stated Daniel Wettreich, chairman and CEO of Camelot. "There has been no fundamental change in the company."
The company said it has in excess of $3 million cash in the bank, no debt and stockholders equity of approximately $15 million.
Camelot is a holding company with subsidiaries focused on software development and Internet access.
